title: Add published release bootstrap acceptance

context.summary: Add an acceptance path that verifies a public GitHub pre-release can be bootstrapped from its signed manifest and release assets.
context.background: TASK-119 changed the release workflow to publish trusted tag builds as public pre-releases. The next gate needs to prove the public manifest URL, public key sidecar, bundle checksum and packaged installer dry-run work from a clean temporary home.

in: Teach release install smoke to download manifests and bundles from public HTTPS release URLs.
Add a published-release acceptance script with default dry-run validation and opt-in live GitHub release verification.
Exercise install.sh verify-only plus packaged installer plan in live mode.
Document the published pre-release bootstrap acceptance command.
Include the dry-run acceptance in pnpm check.
out: Starting Docker Compose as part of this acceptance; live Docker self-host acceptance is TASK-121.
Implementing local model auto-install or Web UI tasks.

acceptance_criteria: Release smoke supports --manifest-url and downloads the matching public key sidecar and bundle before checksum verification.
Published-release acceptance dry-run validates script/docs wiring without network access.
Published-release acceptance live mode verifies install.sh --verify-only against the public pre-release manifest URL.
Published-release acceptance live mode extracts the downloaded bundle into a temp MINDORY_HOME and runs the packaged installer plan command.
Failure output clearly reports missing draft/private release assets or download/signature/checksum problems.
pnpm published-release:acceptance, pnpm bootstrap:validate, pnpm release:validate, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Publish v0.1.0 as a GitHub pre-release before running live acceptance.
Run MINDORY_PUBLISHED_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true pnpm published-release:acceptance once the release assets are public.

risks: Live acceptance depends on GitHub release assets being public and reachable.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
